questions: Is the operation symmetric? That is, if we replace every occurrence of x with y, does that also implicitly replace every occurrence of y with x, or is it a one-way replacement?
Can x and y be the same letter? If so, does that count as an operation?
Are we allowed to choose x and y that are not present in S? For example, replacing a letter not in S with another letter.
When replacing x with y, if y already appears in S, do those occurrences remain unchanged or are they also replaced (since they are occurrences of y, not x)?
Does the operation apply to the current state of S after previous operations, or only to the original S each time?
Is the goal to make S identical to T exactly at the end of all operations, or after each operation?
If multiple minimal sequences exist, are we required to output the minimum number, or any sequence length?
Are there any constraints on the order of operations? For example, must we choose distinct x and y each time?
